value: Good morning, Aisha! This week in your career briefing, you’re diving into Docker with Pod Orbit. Your focus is sharp: start with Docker’s Get Started guide covering images, containers, and volumes. Then, run, inspect, and stop three containers from Docker Hub. Finally, containerise the captioning API as part of pod issue number one. Great news—your own issue to set up the Docker environment for the project has already been merged, with Priya reviewing. On the market front, large language model evaluations are soaring, up 67% a year, and LLM applications are growing 45% annually. Your pod’s momentum is strong at 206%, and with one pod merge done, you’re off to a flying start this November. Keep pushing forward, Aisha—your skills with Docker will open many doors!
